answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 59347 Country: India Title: Koonda Question: I would like to know about Koonda ritual which is celebrate in sunni Muslim they perform Fatiha. Is this correct? Please tell me about koonda. Answer ID: 59347 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 482/447/SN=07/1436) The ritual of kunda and the practice of Fatiha with particular conditions is baseless. It is not proved from the Holy Quran and Hadith. It was also not practiced by Sahabah, Tabi’een, Ayemma Mujtahidin etc. It is bida’h and unlawful. It is not lawful for Muslims to practice it or help it or participate in it. (Fatawa Mahmoodia, 3/281, pub. Dabhel). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
